title: GD's Melee mod source index (gdmelee-mods.json)
description: The list of mods one source offers to the GD's Melee mods browser. See docs/mods-browser.md.

id.description: The mod's id: also its folder name in mods/. Lower-case letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'.

version.description: Any string; a different string than the installed one offers an update.

kind.description: As in mod.json (docs/mods-packaging.md). 'script' = only Lua scripts.

pack.description: The family a mod belongs to (e.g. a split mod disc).

api_version.description: Scripts only: the scripting API the mod needs (docs/scripting.md).

url.description: The mod's zip: an https URL, or a path relative to the index's own URL. The zip has mod.json at its top level (or inside one top folder), then files/ and/or scripts/.
